answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 15 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 925 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The raven of the curve is the gate, the glacier of the reset is the trap, and the echo of the history is the asset no farm can print.
